messages.text: A and I both want the trailer in the next few weeks, and neither of us is backing down. B's pad is where it lives, so she is stuck in the middle. Can you help the three of us sort this out?
I don’t have exact dates or a duration yet. I need the trailer sometime in the next few weeks for my home project, and I’m not willing to wait until A is done with it.

I don’t need it myself, and I can’t think of any particular dates that would be inconvenient. I’d rather it not stay on my pad much longer, though I rent and would need my landlord’s okay for any change to what’s kept there.
I don’t have exact dates yet. I want to use it for weekend trips over the next few weeks, but I can’t give you a firm window or duration yet.
Alternating weekends could work, but I’m not agreeing to wait until A is done. I can’t name a weekend yet; I need a turn sometime in the next few weeks.
Alternating weekends could work, but I can’t name the first one yet. I don’t want to commit to set weekends before my trip dates are settled.
Yes, as a starting point. I need a turn in the next few weeks, though—I don’t want first-come booking to leave me waiting indefinitely.
Yes, that works. I’ll ask B when I have dates, and if we want the same weekend, we can alternate priority.
Yes, I can keep the list and confirm bookings with both of them. I’d still be glad to have the trailer off my pad when it’s not needed.
I accept the two-turn fairness rule, but I still need a turn in the next few weeks. Without that, the plan doesn’t settle my concern.
